interface.longDescription: Bible study, sermons and teaching grounded in the preserved Church of Christ v9 doctrinal framework. Includes 54 skills, 30 specialist capabilities, six shared engines, a research laboratory, sermon studio, personal biblical knowledge base, visual education studio and draft-first Church UA integration. Ukrainian is the default; English and Russian are supported. Intended for adult teachers, ministers and authors. Local library, persistent workflows and Python exports require a host with an available code executor. Church UA submission requires separately configured authorized access; installation grants no congregation access. AI output needs review and does not guarantee theological, historical or factual accuracy.
defaultPrompt: Explain Luke 15:1–10 in context, including its argument and practical implications.
Write a sustained sermon grounded in a carefully interpreted biblical passage.
Prepare a Bible lesson with teaching objectives, discussion and source notes.
